name: vehicle-video-analysis
description: Extract auditable video frames and review adjacent-frame motion continuity without estimating physical speed.

interface.shortDescription: Extract frames and review motion continuity
interface.longDescription: Extract traceable frame-level timing data from videos, then review strict adjacent-frame motion continuity in a separate analysis stage. The plugin does not estimate physical vehicle speed.
defaultPrompt: 提取这个视频指定播放器时间区间的帧图片和逐帧CSV。
复核这个视频指定区间的相邻帧运动连续性。
